episode_row: first scheduler day: later lineup did not re-trigger predictions

commits.subject: fix(scheduler): always run predictions at each check, don't skip
commits.body:
The skip-if-no-new-confirmations optimization had a bug: a game
marked confirmed because the *opposing* team posted a lineup would
not re-trigger when the picked team's lineup posted later.

Removed the gate. Every scheduled check runs the full prediction
cascade — the pipeline determines projected vs confirmed per-batter.
Cost is ~2.5min SSH per check, 7 checks/day max. Worth it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
